text: Mobil is one of ExxonMobil's fuel brands: per Exxon Mobil Corporation's FY2025 10-K, its retail fuels sites sell products and services throughout the world through its Exxon, Esso, and Mobil brands.
short: Mobil is a fuel brand of Exxon Mobil Corporation (NYSE: XOM).

source.name: Exxon Mobil Corporation, Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025 (SEC EDGAR)
source.quote: retail fuels sites sell products and services throughout the world through our Exxon , Esso, and Mobil brands
